summary: Iter18 — Auto-assign (no Accept step) verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed. Session goes directly to status='open' after Lily handoff when an agent is online (no pending state); assigned_agent_id populated; pending_agent_id/pending_expires_at are None; agent WS receives 'new_session' event (NOT 'pending_offer'); default sessions listing includes the new session immediately (no /accept needed); no status='pending' sessions leak into the active view; no stale iter1*/TEST_Iter17 sessions in active view (only archived closed ones remain, which is expected). Queued path also works: with both admin & agent offline, session becomes status='queued' with queue_position; bringing an agent back online promotes it directly to 'open' via promote_from_queue. Frontend: agent /dashboard renders WITHOUT any pending-offers element; a session created via API + handoff appears in [data-testid='sessions-list'] within 408ms with 'Open' badge; agent can click and reply without any Accept action; agent-side pending-offers section stays at 0 offers throughout. Customer widget: Lily→chat transitions directly (waiting-agent-view NEVER visible), chat-input visible immediately, customer message sent successfully, 0 console errors.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-assign flow: (1) POST /api/chat/session/anonymous returns {session_id, session_token, ...} (note key is `session_id`, not `id`), status='lily'. (2) POST /api/lily/handoff?session_id=X&session_token=Y&lang=en — this transitions status to 'open' (if agent online) or 'queued' (if not) and broadcasts a `new_session` WS event to agents. NEVER expect 'pending_offer' events or status='pending' anywhere in the happy path. Agent /dashboard: [data-testid='sessions-list'] is the active list; [data-testid='pending-offers'] is legacy and should have 0 children. Customer widget: `queue_promoted` event transitions phase directly to 'chat' — [data-testid='waiting-agent-view'] should NEVER be visible in the auto-assign path. To force queued path in tests: POST /api/agents/status {status:'offline'} for BOTH admin and agent (both are eligible agents).
